description.value:
Requirements You are in Storm Surge Stance.

You gather the forces of water and swing in a large circle around you, conjuring a whirlpool of water that carries you effortlessly to your targets. Water erupts in a 30-foot emanation around you, and its waves propel you towards a creature within the emanation, allowing you to Strike them. The waves can carry you to another creature to Strike up to two more times, each time targeting a different creature within the emanation. You do not increase your multi-attack penalty until after all of your Strikes are made.

After you’ve made your Strikes, the whirlpool of water roils and tries to throw your opponents off-balance. Enemies of your choice in the emanation must make a @Check[fortitude|against:class-save], and creatures you have struck treat their outcome as one degree of success worse. On a failed save, you can move a creature up to 10 feet within the emanation, but on a critical failure, you can either knock them @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} or move them anywhere else within the emanation.
